mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM canteen_stall WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS stallCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS dishCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE deleted = 0) AS feedbackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING') AS pendingFeedbackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND role = 'STUDENT') AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish_favorite) AS favoriteCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rating), 2), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS avgRating, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS goodRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayReviewCount

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, d.image AS image, s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, d.price AS price, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) FROM dish_sales ds WHERE ds.dish_id = d.id
AND ds.sale_date = CURDATE()
AND ds.sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
) AS salesCount, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.id) * 100, 2) AS goodRate FROM dish d INNER JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.image, d.price, s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor
ORDER BY salesCount DESC, avgRating DESC
ORDER BY avgRating DESC, reviewCount DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badCount, COUNT(r.id) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id), 0) * 100, 2) AS goodRate FROM canteen_stall s INNER JOIN dish d ON d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor ORDER BY goodRate DESC, total DESC

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, s.location AS location, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, s.cover_image AS coverImage, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reviewCount, IFNULL(fav.favoriteCount, 0) AS favoriteCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(r.rating), 0) * 15 + COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 1.0 + IFNULL(fav.favoriteCount, 0) * 1.5, 2) AS popularityScore FROM canteen_stall s LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d2.stall_id AS stall_id, COUNT(*) AS favoriteCount FROM dish_favorite f INNER JOIN dish d2 ON f.dish_id = d2.id AND d2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d2.stall_id ) fav ON fav.stall_id = s.id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.location, s.area, s.floor, s.cover_image, fav.favoriteCount ORDER BY popularityScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY) AS d UNION ALL SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_seq WHERE d < CURDATE() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ds.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount FROM date_seq ds LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND DATE(r.create_time) = ds.d GROUP BY ds.d ORDER BY ds.d

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, d.price AS price, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.id) * 100, 2) AS goodRate FROM dish d INNER JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.name, s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor, d.price ORDER BY d.price

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, s.location AS location, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, s.category AS category, s.manager_name AS managerName, s.hygiene_score AS hygieneScore, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS dishCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.id) * 100, 2) AS goodRate FROM canteen_stall s INNER JOIN dish d ON d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 INNER JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.location, s.area, s.floor, s.category, s.manager_name, s.hygiene_score ORDER BY s.hygiene_score

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS stallZone, d.category AS category, d.featured AS featured, d.price AS price, d.image AS image, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id), 0) * 100, 2) AS goodRate FROM dish d INNER JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.name, s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor, d.category, d.featured, d.price ORDER BY d.id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star5, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star4, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star3, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star2, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star1, COUNT(*) AS total FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND dish_id = #{dishId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM canteen_stall WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS stallCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS dishCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS reviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND role = 'STUDENT') AS studentCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM dish_sales) AS totalSalesQty, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2), 0) FROM dish_sales) AS totalSalesAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM dish_sales WHERE sale_date = (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM dish_sales)) AS latestDayQty, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2), 0) FROM dish_sales WHERE sale_date = (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM dish_sales)) AS latestDayAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date), 0)), 0) FROM dish_sales) AS avgDailyQty, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rating), 2), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS avgRating, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS goodRate, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sale_date), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM dish_sales) AS dataDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) AS quantity, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(amount), 2), 0) AS amount FROM dish_sales WHERE sale_date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM dish_sales), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(d.category, ''), '其他') AS category, IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) AS quantity, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ds.amount), 2), 0) AS amount FROM dish_sales ds INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = ds.dish_id AND d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(d.category, ''), '其他') ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, CONCAT(CASE s.area WHEN 'north' THEN '北区' ELSE '南区' END, ' ', s.floor, ' 楼') AS areaLabel, IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) AS quantity, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ds.amount), 2), 0) AS amount, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) FROM dish_review r INNER JOIN dish d2 ON d2.id = r.dish_id AND d2.stall_id = s.id AND d2.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1), 0) AS avgRating FROM dish_sales ds INNER JOIN canteen_stall s ON s.id = ds.stall_id AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, d.image AS image, d.category AS category, d.price AS price, s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) AS quantity, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ds.amount), 2), 0) AS amount FROM dish_sales ds INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = ds.dish_id AND d.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN canteen_stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.image, d.category, d.price, s.id, s.name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 5 AS star, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS count FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 4, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 3, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM dish_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS windowNo, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(r.id), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS goodRate FROM canteen_stall s LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no ORDER BY goodRate DESC, avgRating DESC
